newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton futures called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton futures called to open little changed.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open mostly flat on Tuesday based on market orders at 1017 EDT, dealers said.

Late Monday, the U.S. Department of Agriculture rated 62 percent of the crop in good to excellent condition, compared with 59 percent a week ago. Analysts said the report could have a mildly bearish effect on prices during the session.

Weather in Texas, meanwhile, remains favorable for the maturing crops and harvests continue in the south with no delays, Weather Services Corp said. Recent rainfall has helped developing cotton in the Delta states.
The weekly spec/hedge report revealed the speculators to be holding a net 13.9 percent short position in the market.
Monday, December closed down 0.80 cent on the day at 73.78 cents, having ranged from 74.50 to 73.50 cents. The rest of the board settled 0.18 to 0.86 cent lower.
Analysts said December is likely to fall to its next downside target seen at the contract low of 73.20 cents, amid a lack of bullish fundamental news.
